analysis.visual_description: The bill, on the bookwheel. A small shop-ticket on the chamber table, creased from a sleeve, no new figures added. The door is shut.
The bill, on the bookwheel. The same ticket, two lines under the first. The sums are still unwritten.
The bill, on the bookwheel. The foot of the ticket, a short line, and clean paper under it. No second hand has touched it.
